subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises different spellings of the same sound: ow (cow) / ou (found); aw (draw) / au (autumn)

show.line: Cow and found. Same sound, two spellings, ow and ou. Draw and autumn. Same sound, aw and au!

rounds.prompt: Which word has the same sound as cow?
Which word has the same sound as draw?
This word sounds like cow and has ou in it. It is small and squeaks.
Tap the word that spells house the right way.
ow as in cow, or aw as in draw? Sort the pictures by sound.
Which word has au, as in autumn?
Which word has ow, as in cow?

hints: Say the word slowly. Does it sound like cow or like draw?
ow and ou can sound the same. So can aw and au.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that sounds like cow.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Coat has oa, like boat. Cloud sounds like cow.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Cow, cloud, owl. Same sound!

parent_line: Can hear the ow and aw sounds and knows their two spellings.
